steps.content: [Inside the sand ship]
Inside the OAB security team's sand ship
Hella looks at the young man in front of her with a hint of suspicion. The captain smiles back at her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Cleansing Operation</color> for transport routes...?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: That's right.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: In simple terms, we're a WhiteSands security team formed by the DisCity Outland Affairs Bureau. We blockade and eradicate bandits near transport routes.
A team member standing by the side hands over a document. Hella leans in and sees the seal of the Outland Affairs Bureau on it.
DisCity Outland Affairs Bureau... An image of a furious middle-aged man pops into her mind. He had been rambling about eliminating bandits two years ago. They're still at it?
Seeing Hella's distrustful expression, Scotch continues to explain calmly.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: This round of cleansing should have been completed half a month ago, but the frequent sandstorms have delayed progress...
The man's words are interrupted by a sudden alarm.
The monitor projects the external situation: as Hella had suspected, the ship is surrounded by sandworms. Roaring, ferocious creatures try to climb onto the ship.

Warning: Enemy attack. The ship has entered an active sand beast habitat. Please clear obstacles as soon as possible...

Target locked: Large number of sand beasts. Requesting permission to fire...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are there so many monsters? Those things are tough. Quick, tell your guys to leave her...
Request approved. Countdown: 3, 2, 1...
Fire!
The sandworms on the ship's hull shriek as they fall. The gunfire completely overwhelms the tide of monsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ere...? What the hell? That was so f**king cool!!!
A soft chuckle echoes from beside Hella.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Sailing in a straight line is always the fastest, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: What a perfect opportunity to show our sincerity in collaborating to our MBCC guest... We'll have a proper discussion once it's over.
The cannon muzzle rotates, aiming at the next batch of sand beasts.
